verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Daily itself accepting natural-language commands to operate the product, such as an AI assistant in the dashboard or an NL-driven CLI. Pipecat is a framework for building voice AI agents, and llms.txt and the OpenAPI spec are machine-readable docs. These are developer building blocks that someone could use to construct such a capability, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
